video.title: Priku B2B Traumer @ Berg Audio x Hola Club [OFF SONAR 2026 - FULL SET]
video.description:
Traumer & Priku delivering a masterclass at the label's 10 year celebration OFF Sonar event, soundtracking our journey from sunset into the night. 

🎧 SOUNDCLOUD → https://on.soundcloud.com/Nt2DGZMea9zeX2qY6l

💾 OUR DIGITAL CATALOG → https://bergaudio.bandcamp.com/music (incl. music from Traumer, Kolter, Chris Stussy, Mihai Popoviciu, Priku, Janeret, Andrey Pushkarev & many more 💽)

💿 OUR VINYL CATALOG → https://www.decks.de/decks/workfloor/lists/findLabel.php?label=berg-audio

👕 OUR MERCH → https://barning.eu/collections/berg-audio-x-barning

━

🎧 OUR SPOTIFY PLAYLISTS: https://bit.ly/4eHoXLN
